turns.question: For candidates who reached the interview stage between 30 September and 4 October 2026, what was the median number of days from their application to the interview stage?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the median number of days from application to the interview stage, so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are Time to hire (days), an average over hired candidates only, and Candidates in stage, a per-day count of candidates in each hiring stage; no freshness statement was returned because no figure was queried.
